sentences.en: Russian Protestantism was born in the northwest of Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的路德教是在俄罗斯西北部诞生的。

sentences.en: Chinook Jargon was once widespread in the Pacific Northwest.
sentences.zh: 钦科伊混合语曾经在太平洋西北地区广泛使用。

sentences.en: Ecuador is a country situated in the northwest part of South America.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔位于南美洲西北部。
